text: 中国贸促会对外公布最新一期的全球经贸摩擦指数，数据显示，7月份全球经贸摩擦指数继续处于高位。从综合指数看，2026年7月份全球经贸摩擦指数为101，处于高位。全球经贸摩擦措施涉及金额同比下降18.7%，环比下降2.2%，主要因为去年同期美国、欧盟、印度等密集发布进出口关税措施，推升了指数；今年6月份全球发起68起贸易救济调查，而7月份则回落至17起。（央视新闻）
text_en: The China Council for the Promotion of International Trade released the latest Global Economic and Trade Friction Index, with data showing that the index remained at a high level in July. From the composite index, the Global Economic and Trade Friction Index in July 2026 was 101, at a high level. The amount involved in global economic and trade friction measures fell 18.7% year on year and 2.2% month on month, mainly because the US, EU, India and others密集 introduced import and export tariff measures in the same period last year, pushing up the index; 68 trade remedy investigations were launched globally in June this year, while in July it fell back to 17. (CCTV News)
